content.scenario: A company issued a misleading advertisement claiming its product could cure a specific disease, which was not supported by scientific evidence. The Consumer Commission ordered the company to issue a corrective advertisement in all major newspapers and television channels to neutralize the misleading claim, at a cost of Rs. 50 lakhs.
content.outcome: The company was required to pay the cost of issuing the corrective advertisement, which was Rs. 50 lakhs, to neutralize the misleading advertisement.
